updates.title: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security — General Availability
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Network Data Security now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to protect sensitive data at the network layer, blocking risky transfers to untrusted cloud apps, browsers, and generative AI platforms. This capability enforces DLP policy actions and feeds Insider Risk Management signals, extending data protection beyond Microsoft 365 to APIs and add-ins.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps — Preview
updates.summary: Admins can now create DLP policies to protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft SaaS applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends Purview's classification engine and DLP enforcement beyond Microsoft 365 into third-party cloud environments.

updates.title: Endpoint DLP macOS Permission Changes — Deployment Preparation Required
updates.summary: Microsoft is implementing new permission requirements for Endpoint DLP on macOS 27; admins must deploy client version 101.26072 or later and configure protection modes to maintain coverage. Device Control and Data Access permissions must be enabled, and user notification strategies should be prepared in advance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Priority Cleanup for SharePoint and OneDrive — Preview
updates.summary: Admins can now permanently delete sensitive or non-compliant files from SharePoint and OneDrive by bypassing recycle bins after simulation, review, and approval, improving data lifecycle compliance for departing employees and policy violations. Files deleted via Priority Cleanup are no longer searchable or recoverable.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management — 30-Day Delay Hold for Inactive Mailboxes
updates.summary: When the last hold is removed from an inactive mailbox, Microsoft 365 automatically applies a 30-day delay hold to prevent accidental deletion; admins must identify and remove these delay holds before recalculating mailbox hold status. This change requires awareness of the new hold type to maintain compliance with retention policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management — OneDrive Hold Removal via PowerShell
updates.summary: Admins can now remove retention holds from unlicensed OneDrive sites using Security & Compliance PowerShell, streamlining the process of deleting inactive sites at scale. This new capability covers both tenant-level and site-level holds with updated guidance on prerequisites and error handling.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DSPM — Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) now includes Copilot readiness assessment and an enhanced data explorer to help organizations evaluate sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage. These tools assist security teams in prioritizing remediation and improving data security posture before deploying Copilot.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Protection — Integration with Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: Adaptive Protection now integrates with Data Lifecycle Management to automatically apply retention labels based on users' dynamic insider risk levels determined by data-related activities. This allows organizations to preserve emails and files from high-risk users without manual policy adjustments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations — Endpoint DLP Alert Integration
updates.summary: Security teams can now launch Data Security Investigations directly from endpoint DLP alerts to automatically gather and review exfiltrated files that triggered the alerts. This integration reduces manual effort in correlating endpoint DLP detections with actual data exfiltration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection — Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins now have per-policy coverage reports showing how enforced auto-labeling policies correlate to simulation runs, including volumes of labeled and unlabeled files. This visibility helps track enforcement progress and identify files processed during enforcement that were not captured in simulations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management — Temporary File Noise Reduction
updates.summary: A new feature reduces high-volume, low-signal alerts from operating system and application temporary files in Insider Risk Management by providing enhanced filtering options beyond existing global exclusions. This helps security teams focus on genuine risky activities rather than normal Windows and application behavior.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management — Automatic Deletion of Inactive User Containers
updates.summary: Admins can now automatically delete both content and containers (OneDrives and mailboxes) for departed users at scale, helping organizations maintain regulatory compliance without manual intervention. This streamlines the offboarding process and reduces storage associated with inactive user accounts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery — In-Product Self-Service Diagnostics
updates.summary: eDiscovery admins now have built-in self-service diagnostics to identify and resolve common configuration issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. This reduces troubleshooting time and helps prevent misconfigurations that could impact legal holds and case integrity.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management — Sensitive Data Insights and Policy Recommendations
updates.summary: Admins receive automated insights and retention policy recommendations for sensitive data in OneDrive and SharePoint, helping organizations establish better data governance and compliance postures. These recommendations are based on sensitivity classifications and usage patterns.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP — Island Enterprise Browser Integration
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview network data security now integrates with Island's enterprise browser to extend DLP protection to unmanaged cloud app workflows, including HTTP/HTTPS traffic through the Island browser and extensions. Admins can apply the same sensitivity labels, classifiers, and sensitive information types across browser-based activities.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management — Legacy Teams Retention Policies and Copilot Separation
updates.summary: Existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams will be converted to Teams-only policies and will no longer implicitly apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. Organizations must review and update retention policies if they intend to govern Copilot workloads separately.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP — Cross-Tenant Teams Chat Policy Enforcement
updates.summary: In cross-tenant Microsoft Teams chats and channels, DLP policy enforcement now follows the tenant that initiated the conversation; a user's home-tenant policies no longer automatically apply to conversations hosted in another tenant. This change clarifies policy boundary and may require admins to adjust policies for shared cross-tenant scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP — Exchange Label Selection and Policy Tip Reevaluation
updates.summary: When an Exchange DLP policy uses sensitivity labels as a condition with policy tips enabled and mandatory labeling is enforced, selecting a label from the mandatory-labeling prompt no longer reevaluates the policy tip. However, the configured DLP enforcement action is still applied, which may affect user experience and compliance workflows.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Governance — Azure Region Co-Location Requirement
updates.summary: The Data Quality capability in Data Governance now requires the Microsoft Purview account and all connected data sources to reside in the same Azure region. Organizations must review their data source configurations to ensure compliance with this co-location requirement.
